correctness.rationale: Finite group stabilizer injects into Frobenius centralizer C3, so only trivial/C3 stabilizers. A nontrivial element fixes two points of the quadratic place, forcing q congruent 2 mod 3. In that case there are exactly q(q-1) order-three elements; each preserves a unique quadratic place and 2(q+1)/3 cubic places by separable q+1 twisted-Frobenius equations. Double counting pairs (divisor, nonidentity stabilizer) produces exactly one C3 orbit; all remaining orbits free and yield both displayed formulas. The explicit exceptional polynomial is reduced. Programmatically independent PGL2 orbit enumeration checks q=2,3,5,7,11,13; proof, not enumeration, handles all prime powers.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural arithmetic Frobenius-splitting stratum of the moduli of unordered five branch points. It includes the exact orbit count, all stabilizer orders and unique nonsplit symmetry orbit for every prime power and a canonical polynomial representative, data needed to assemble finite-field stack masses; it is not merely a q-specific computed number, name substitution or an irreducible-case corollary. Does not purport to count covers or full curve automorphisms.
